heading, More clarity, more confidence, more control, level 3

Careology helps you stay connected, informed and supported every day. It works alongside your healthcare team and brings in the people who matter most to you, so you never feel alone in managing your care.
image, Mother and daughter making funny faces together
heading, Feel more in control, level 3

Cancer treatment can be overwhelming, with so much to manage. Careology helps you keep on top of everything, with guidance and advice on how to manage symptoms and side effects, share how you feel with your healthcare teams, and get reminders of appointments and when to take your medications. Your family and friends can even see how you are doing through their own Caregiver app. It provides useful tools to support them and you, such as recipes to cook for you, so you feel connected and cared for.
heading, Here for the UpDays and the DownDays, level 3
Careology is built with input gained from the people who face the challenges of a cancer diagnosis to really understand their needs.
Careology 'listens' to you, to provide specific information and guidance based on how you’re feeling and the symptoms you’re experiencing.
heading, All in one place, level 3
From an appointment calendar to a digital journal, Careology takes care of your treatment admin so everything is safely stored, quick to view and easily visible to your healthcare team.
We’ve spoken to several of the past and present users of our app to find out what they found the most useful, practical and comforting about Careology.

end of heading, A guide, level 3
Careology doesn’t just support, it guides as well, helping you focus on what you need to do that day. Whether that’s to remember medication or feedback symptoms.
“We’ve found that patients are more accepting of your help - they like the comfort blanket that allows them to be quietly taken care of, it’s discreet."
Pharmacy Manager and Registered Technician at Nuffield Health
heading, Careology supports you and your teams, level 3
image, Medical professional in blue scrubs with a stethoscope holding a digital tablet
Better informed and well-equipped to provide care specific to your diagnosis, treatment and needs.
image, Two people in casual attire sitting and reading books on a sofa.
Support and connection beyond the hospital walls.
image, Two individuals at a kitchen counter with a laptop and headphones.
More information and more peace of mind, to feel able to support you better.

Careology was created to help people with cancer and their care teams make better-informed decisions every day. We combine intuitive technology with clinical excellence to bring clarity, connection and confidence throughout your cancer journey. By empowering you and your network, we help create more of the up days - and support on the down days.
